goal: Rust-own the baseline public ds4_gpu_set_model_map, ds4_gpu_set_model_fd, ds4_gpu_set_model_map_range, and ds4_gpu_cache_model_range ABI surfaces through the validated caller-map device-copy cache without claiming residency-policy optimization branches or route promotion.

semantics: set_model_map rejects null or empty mappings and replaces previously cached model ranges on a new mapping identity
set_model_fd accepts the ABI value while fd-backed staging policy remains a separate residency branch
the baseline set_model_map_range path records the mapping; environment-selected chunked copy and HMM prefetch are not claimed
cache_model_range preserves zero-byte no-op success, rejects invalid nonzero ranges, and makes valid cached weights usable by model-backed compute

implementation.range_path: ABI_MODEL_CONTROL plus ABI_MODEL_RANGES; mapping replacement synchronizes and clears retained device-copy ranges before recording a new model map
implementation.linked_compute_consumer: ds4_gpu_rms_norm_weight_tensor consumes a range pre-populated by ds4_gpu_cache_model_range
implementation.remaining_residency_policy_boundary: registered mapped-host model ranges, pageable HMM/prefetch, fd-backed direct-I/O staging, environment-selected preload/copy policy, and q8/f16 cache hooks remain pending

b300_execution.non_release_feature_test_blocker: the shared reusable module still includes SwiGLU, whose std::f32::<impl f32>::exp device code is rejected by non-release cuda-oxide code generation before libdevice lowering
b300_execution.staticlib_build_command: cargo build --locked --release --features cuda-oxide-kernels -p ds4-cuda --lib with rustc-codegen-cuda
b300_execution.linker_warning: generated embed object lacks .note.GNU-stack and currently warns about an executable stack

integration_risks: the public controls currently own only caller-map device-copy caching and do not select registered host mapping, pageable HMM, fd-backed direct-I/O, preload, whole-model copy, or q8/f16 cache policy
set_model_fd is accepted for ABI linkage but is not yet consumed by fd-backed staging
the embedded module object has no retaining symbol, so consumers must retain the complete static archive until production build integration provides an equivalent mechanism
the generated embed object currently produces an executable-stack linker warning that should be resolved before production route promotion
the cuda-oxide non-release feature build remains blocked by reusable-library SwiGLU exponential device code in the shared module
